intent.title: Interactions: a trigger plays a timeline, reusable by name and applicable to a class
steps: Select an element, open Interactions and add one: it plays a new timeline named after the element and the trigger.
Choose each trigger of the catalogue and set its options; make another element play the same timeline by name; apply it to every .card.
expected: Every trigger of the catalogue is offered where it applies, with its options.
The interaction is stored on the element, its timeline in the project; each change is one undo step.

intent.title: A real Timeline in seconds: tracks per target and per property, action bars, playhead, markers
steps: Open the Timeline, add each action of the catalogue after, with or at the playhead; drag bars and their edges; pick targets on the canvas or in Layers; add markers.
expected: The axis is in seconds with zoom; the readout says "0.48 s / 1.20 s"; bars snap to edges, keyframes, markers and the playhead.

intent.title: Keyframes on a seconds axis, with per-segment easing, copy and paste, and record mode
steps: Add a keyframe at the playhead, animate another property, change values, easings and times, drag and delete keyframes, copy and paste them, record inspector changes.
expected: Each property is its own track; an inspector change while recording becomes a keyframe at the playhead.

intent.title: Preview a timeline on the canvas and run the interactions in the editor
steps: Play, pause and stop the open timeline; turn Run interactions on and click the element.
expected: The canvas draws the timeline at the playhead; in run mode the canvas runs the interactions as the page does.

intent.title: Behaviours: sticky, scroll snap, smooth scroll, parallax, looping marquee, cursor follow
steps: Give an element each behaviour and change its amount and axis.
expected: Sticky and scroll snap are plain CSS written through the style owner; the others run from the motion script and respect reduced motion.

intent.title: Motion exported as plain JavaScript on WAAPI and native scroll timelines
steps: Add an interaction and export the site.
expected: js/motion.js holds the runtime and the site's motion data; the pages that use motion link it; Lottie only when used.
